text:
alex: Quick heads-up — publish is blocked on CI. regendiff shows a changelog ordering change that made the release script bump a minor instead of a patch. also seeing sample app auth flaky test fail after regen.

maria: Ugh. Can you paste the regendiff snippet? is it the doc ordering (examples) or actual API surface?

alex: It's only in changelog markdown files under docs/releases. The generated CHANGELOG.md now has a new heading order: features above fixes which our semver parser treats as a minor. The diff: 
```diff
-### Fixes
-
-- fixed small typo in auth retry docs
+### Features
+
+added "automatic-retry" note for SDKs
```
Not an API change, but the changelog parser is naive and looks for "Features" -> minor bump.

tyler: devops note: release-bot triggered because `release-bot guard` relies on header semantics. We can short-circuit, but need a quick fix for the CI gating rules.

devex-bot: CI check `regendiff-check` failed on 1736001300. Log: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345/regendiff. Error: semver-bump: minor detected.

samira: Related: my flutter sample app tests started failing in the auth retry integration after typegen regen. The test expecting single 401->retry sequence now sees two retries, which the test interprets as a change. Test snippet: 
```dart
// expect only one retry on transient 401
expect(retryCount, equals(1));
```
Locally rolling back the typegen restore makes the test pass.

maria: Could the changelog reorder have been caused by a tooling change in typegen that now emits changelog fragments in alphabetical order? We landed that sorting PR in codegen last week.

alex: Exactly my suspicion. typegen changed fragment concatenation order when `--stable-sort` flag was flipped in the build. It bubbled into the changelog generator. The semver parser should ignore changelog headings, but sadly it doesn't.

tyler: Quick mitigation: we can update the release script to prefer `patch` if only docs files changed. But we need to detect docs-only vs codegen changes robustly. For now, patch: add a pre-release hook to check `git diff --name-only HEAD~1 | grep -qE "^(docs/|CHANGELOG)"` and force patch.

jen: As release lead, I'd prefer a less fragile path. Two asks: (1) revert the codegen stable-sort change if it's the cause, (2) make regendiff-check ignore changelog headings in semver detection. Which is faster?

maria: Reverting the codegen PR is low-risk but may reintroduce nondetiness we previously eliminated. Fixing regendiff-check is small: change the parser to strip changelog headings and only look at OpenAPI diffs and API surface markers. I can open a quick PR to strip /CHANGELOG.md and docs/releases content from semver calculation.

samira: Meanwhile, for the sample app tests: my current workaround is pinning the typegen artifact to the previous hash in the sample app CI. It unblocks the release but it's temporary. The underlying auth/retry semantics may have actually changed — worth validating.

alex: Good call. @samira can you run `typegen --dump-metadata` on both hashes and share the `retry_policy` diff?

samira: Ran it. Diff shows a new default `max_retries: 2` for the dart SDK generator, previous was `1`. Snippet: 
```yaml
- retry_policy:
-   max_retries: 1
+ retry_policy:
+   max_retries: 2
```
So codegen changed default behavior for Dart. That explains the doubled retries.

tyler: That's a production-impacting change. We need to treat default behavioral changes as a minor at least, but since it's across SDKs it should have been communicated. Where did this change land?

maria: Found the commit: codegen/sdk-defaults: baked-in unified retry policy (commit 9f8a2c). It was intended to standardize across languages but wasn't in the release notes.

jen: Action items: 
- maria: PR to regendiff-check to ignore changelog headings and docs-only changes for semver calculation (urgent).
- tyler: hotfix script to force patch if only docs changed in next release (temporary).
- alex + samira: validate whether `max_retries: 2` is intended; if not, revert or gate by language. Also update sample app tests to be explicit about expected behavior (make test assert on config not implicit retries).
- devex-bot: open a ticket referencing 9f8a2c and link the CI run.

devex-bot: Created issue #INF-8472: "Unexpected SDK retry default change from codegen commit 9f8a2c — impacts sample apps and semver detection" and attached regendiff output.

samira: I'll file a follow-up PR to make the dart sample app test assert `config.maxRetries == 1` when we pin the behavior; then flip to use the new default once we've agreed.

alex: Thanks. For today's release, I'm going to pin typegen artifact in the publish job and re-run. If CI passes I'll unstick the publish and we can plan the wider fix for next week.

maria: I'll start the regendiff-check PR now, tag @jen for review.

jen: Thanks all — please keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

samira: Update 1736004000: pinned artifact, reran publish job — CI is green. Release unblocked.

alex: Closing loop: we've got a follow-up plan and an INF ticket. Leaving notes in the release doc about the temporary pin.

jen: Great job. We'll schedule a postmortem with codegen owners to coordinate cross-SDK behavioral changes before they land.

maria: noted — adding to next devex sync agenda.
